responsibility: Provides the canonical table of diagnostic severities and pseudo-severities used by the diagnostics subsystem. Through repeated inclusion it defines the stable set of kinds such as fatal, error, warning, note, path, pedwarn, werror, and internal-only values like unspecified and ignored, along with their default textual prefixes and associated color categories; it is the data source used to generate enums and kind-specific helpers, not executable logic.
same_name_distinction: Unlike kinds.h, which exposes typed declarations generated from the stem-mate, this .def file is the X-macro data table listing each diagnostic kind with its prefix text and color category for repeated inclusion.
